# Modular Arithmetic Challenge

> Modular Arithmetic Challenge. Neural induction of exact (a x b) mod p
> through abacus embeddings, algorithmic scratchpads and grokking, for the
> SAIR Foundation competition.

Author: Amey Thakur, ORCID 0000-0001-5644-1575
